A's short drill box explicitly covers both directions (cover meanings, then cover codes) and stays brief, while B only tells the user, in a tiny footer, to quiz one way. B's monospace codes look nice, but A gives better support for testing from memory. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both sheets list all ten signals with the exact meanings in a clean, legible one-page table, and neither uses external assets.
